# suo5 server templates

These server-side templates are copied from the official suo5 repository:

- Repository: https://github.com/zema1/suo5
- Version: v2.2.0
- Commit: 6904c18e276c2dc36250838d68135a5893c4f66b
- License: see `LICENSE`

Files:

- `suo5.jsp` from `assets/java/suo5.jsp`
- `suo5.aspx` from `assets/dotnet/suo5.aspx`
- `suo5.php` from `assets/php/suo5.php`
- `suo5.js` from `assets/nodejs/suo5.js`

The Payload Factory copies these templates without runtime downloads.
